# Topic Desk Studio v0.4.3 — English

This update improves source management and adds selective local-data cleanup.

- Add NetEase News using its official mobile hot-news feed.
- Keep enabled sources at the top and disabled sources in a collapsed section. Discover's source filter lists enabled sources only.
- Preserve saved source switches when reopening settings or saving an older editor draft.
- Skip disabled sources before queued requests start and discard results returned after a source is disabled.
- Add one-click actions to disable domestic or international sources.
- Refresh the source-management layout with scope counts, source cards, and grouped actions.
- Choose which local data to clear: collected data, browsing history, download records, website sign-ins, or local backups. All choices start unchecked and require confirmation.
- Clearing website sign-ins logs out websites and closes reading tabs. Clearing backups removes manual backups and pre-upgrade snapshots. Downloaded files, source configuration, and encrypted model credentials are retained.
- Simplify cleanup confirmation text and report partial cleanup failures explicitly.

---

# Topic Desk Studio v0.4.3 — 中文

本次更新优化数据源管理，并新增本地数据分类清除功能。

- 新增网易新闻，接入官方移动热榜。
- 已启用来源置顶，关闭的来源默认折叠；发现选题的来源筛选仅展示已启用来源。
- 重新打开设置或保存旧编辑草稿时，保持已保存的数据源开关状态。
- 排队任务请求前检查开关，数据源关闭后返回的结果不再入库。
- 新增一键关闭国内或国外数据源。
- 优化来源管理布局，增加数量概览、来源卡片和操作分组。
- 支持选择清除采集数据、浏览历史、下载记录、网站登录数据或本地备份；默认不勾选，执行前需确认。
- 清除网站登录数据会退出网站并关闭阅读标签页；清除备份会删除手动备份和升级前快照。保留下载文件、数据源配置及加密保存的模型凭据。
- 精简清除确认文案，并明确提示部分清除失败的情况。
